newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police arrest three top Mafia fugitives.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police arrest three top Mafia fugitives.

text.p: Spanish police said on Friday they had arrested three of Italy's most-wanted mafia mobsters, accused of more than 40 murders.
In an operation conducted with Italian and Dutch police, arrests were also made in Italy and Holland and police said 300 kg (660 lb) of cocaine had been seized.

"(Spanish) police arrested three of the most prominent members of the Calabrese mafia group who were found in our country, on the run from Italian police...who were accused of more than 40 murders," police said in a press statement.
They said they had captured the head of one of the most violent clans of the Calabrese crime group named only as "D.P.", together with his aide "G.P." and another senior member of the clan "L.M.".
"These arrests formed part of a much wider operation, with two arrested in Holland and 18 in Italy."
Police said they expected more arrests in Spain. The clan was believed to have also been involved in kidnapping, drugs trafficking, money laundering and extortion.
